ImageDescription.value: Lipka Cave - an artificially created cave, originally used for sand mining, was about 15 meters long and 2 meters wide, but after the collapse of its ceiling, it formed only a kind of sloping corridor, which descends only to a depth of about 5 meters. Czech Republic, okres Česká Lípa, Liberecký kraj; Lipka cave is situated above the village of Horní Prysk in a saddle between Šenovský vrch (632 m above sea level) and the basalt hill Lipka (510 m above sea level).
